settings.title: Remote Control Lawn Mower — 119% Slope (Grip Tread)
settings.description: Sit on your porch. Grab the controller. Watch the S1 4WD conquer 50° (119% Grade) slopes while you stay cool in the shade. 3.94" obstacle clearance, 1000W traction, and a 21" deck with 1985W peak cutting power — the S1 rips through 51" tall grass, wet patches, and dense weeds that defeat every other mower. From the first spring mow to the last fall cleanup: discharge, mulch, bag, and a 931 CFM leaf-shredding vacuum with 70 L collection bag.

settings.title: Remote Control Lawn Mower — 85% Slope (Wide Wheel)
settings.description: The S1 4WD Wide Wheel Edition climbs 40° (85% Grade) slopes with a wider TPU contact patch and bold straight-tread pattern for stronger grip on steeper lawns, damp grass, and soft ground. Same 4-Motor AWD platform, 21" deck, 1985W peak cutting power, and 3.94" obstacle clearance as the 50° — with the sweet-spot tire for everyday steep terrain.

settings.title: Autosteering System
settings.description: The AF718 is Vesper's next-generation high-performance autosteering system. Powered by an advanced computing platform, it significantly enhances accuracy and efficiency across diverse farming operations.
